_comment: Species definitions. Stats are base values; actual stats are derived per level by SpeciesData.compute_stat. 'temperament' drives Attunement (docs/DESIGN.md section 1). 'attunement_rate' scales how fast Resonance builds -- lower is harder to tame. Validated by tools/validate_data.py.

creatures.name: Thistlecalf
creatures.description: A yearling grazer, matted to the shoulder in burr-thistle it has stopped trying to shed. Bolts at a raised hand.

creatures.name: Cairnling
creatures.description: Seven stones stacked by nobody, in an order it will restore if you knock them down. It waits for you to finish.

creatures.name: Skirling
creatures.description: Audible well before it is visible. Hunts the high air over the moor and comes down only to argue.

creatures.name: Sloughback
creatures.description: Carries a hand's depth of the fen on its back, complete with its own small weather. Moves once a minute and regrets it.

creatures.name: Emberwick
creatures.description: Burns from a wick that runs its whole length. It is aware of how much of itself is left and does not discuss it.

creatures.name: Gloamkin
creatures.description: Easier to see from the side than head-on. Keeps to the hour between the sun going and the dark arriving, and is thinner outside it.

creatures.name: Moorhound
creatures.description: Runs the ridgeline in a straight line for hours. Will not be driven off, and will not be first to look away.
